description: Generate synthetic rows as JSON, JSONL or CSV. Use for data import/export tests; use generate-fake-data for preset people or company fixtures. Returns at most eight records without accessing a database.

count.description: Number of records to generate, 1–8, default 3.

format.description: Output format: json, jsonl or csv.

schema.description: Optional map of field names to upstream synthetic field specifications; no real records.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for reproducible test rows.

name: generate-dataset
title: Generate a small synthetic dataset
